therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: left ventricular hypertrophy regression / cardiac remodeling attenuation
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: CKD stage 5 patients on hemodialysis with left ventricular hypertrophy
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Change from baseline in left ventricular mass index (LVMI) over 48 weeks measured by cardiac MRI

biomarker_changes: T3 change from baseline: paricalcitol +0.005 nmol/L vs placebo -0.152 nmol/L
Troponin-T change from baseline: paricalcitol -0.014 mcg/L vs placebo -0.007 mcg/L
IL-6 change from baseline: paricalcitol -0.200 cm/sec vs placebo +0.333 cm/sec
hsCRP change from baseline: paricalcitol +1.104 mg/L vs placebo -0.762 mg/L
BNP change from baseline: paricalcitol -134.200 ng/L vs placebo +572.800 ng/L

dose_info.schedule: three times a week during dialysis

context.indication: Chronic kidney disease stage 5 with left ventricular hypertrophy on hemodialysis
context.duration: Up to 48 weeks (study terminated early; subjects followed 4–16 weeks)
context.investigator_commentary: This study was prematurely terminated due to low enrollment. No subject reached Week 24; early termination visit range was 4–16 weeks.
